data.title: Sun Trigger
data.notes: Trigger xyOps schedules based on sun using https://api.sunrise-sunset.org/ API

params.title: Execute after sunrise/sunset
params.caption: Select whether the job should be executed after sunrise or sunset.

params.title: Latitude
params.caption: Latitude Coordinate to get sunrise info for.

params.title: Longitude
params.caption: Longitude Coordinate to get sunrise info for.

params.title: Offset in Minutes
params.caption: Offset is in minutes and can be negative. For example if a job should run 2 minutes before sunrise, set the offset to -2.

params.title: Caching Directory
params.caption: To avoid many API calls the API answer can be cached to disc.
